scholarships.title: International Excellence Scholarship 2027 (The University of Newcastle, Australia)
scholarships.funding_label: Tuition Fee Waiver (20% of gross annual international tuition fee)

existing.description: The University of Newcastle's International Excellence Scholarship awards a tuition fee reduction equivalent to 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee to high-performing international students commencing a CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree in 2027 or later. No application is required: eligibility is assessed automatically when the student applies for admission, and the value is notified in the Letter of Offer. The University states the indicative number available as 500.
eligibility: Be an international full fee-paying student
Commence study in an eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree program
Not be the beneficiary of a separate University scholarship unless prior approval for special dispensation has been obtained
Be able to meet the financial obligations of a full fee-paying international student specified by the Australian Government, with evidence provided if requested
Not be enrolled in a program covered under a quota arrangement that limits international enrolments
Reside within 50 km of the campus location specified on the Confirmation of Enrolment
existing.eligibility_summary: International full fee-paying students commencing an eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at the University of Newcastle, not in a quota-limited program, not holding another University scholarship, and residing within 50 km of the campus on their Confirmation of Enrolment. Must be able to meet the financial obligations of a full fee-paying international student as specified by the Australian Government.
benefits: 20% reduction of gross annual international tuition fee, applied as a fee waiver after each Census date
coverage: 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee, applied as a tuition fee reduction each term on a pro-rata basis. Living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered.
requirements: Must remain an international student enrolled in an eligible program
Must maintain the conditions of the scholarship for the fee waiver to be applied each term
Must reside within 50 km of the campus specified on the Confirmation of Enrolment
application_method: No application is required for this scholarship
Scholarships are automatically assessed upon application for admission to the University
Eligible students receive notification of the scholarship value within the Letter of Offer
existing.selection_notes: Awards are made on the basis of eligibility, aligned to the University's published entry and eligibility requirements, and at the absolute discretion of the University. The page states that some students may not be offered the scholarship even if criteria are met.
existing.best_fit: International students applying for 2027 or later entry to an eligible CRICOS-registered coursework degree at the University of Newcastle who live near the campus and are not quota-limited.
existing.notes: Awarded automatically on admission rather than by a scholarship application. Excluded: English Language Bridging Program, Enabling, Non-Award, Exchange, Study Abroad, Higher Degrees by Research, degrees without a CRICOS code, standalone Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma programs, offshore or online delivery, internal transfers at an Australian campus, students sponsored by an external entity, recipients of Australia Awards scholarships, and students transferring from the University's Singapore campus. The tuition fee waiver may not appear on the tuition account until after Census date.
existing.duration: Ongoing for each term of the eligible program, provided the conditions of the scholarship are maintained
existing.application_period: For new international students who receive an offer and commence study in 2027 or later. Assessed automatically upon application for admission.
existing.deadline_display: No application deadline - scholarships are automatically assessed on application for admission for 2027 or later commencement
